title: ELDER
hero_prompt: A wide medieval illuminated-manuscript woodcut: a hooded figure stands at a low stone threshold between a modest house and a cluttered workshop behind them, gold-leaf hatching along the doorway's edge, deep woodcut black lines throughout the scene.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast icon: a single arched doorway cut in thick black woodcut linework, one half filled solid gold, the other left plain stone, no fine detail. A flat single-colour silhouette on a plain ground: no shading, no gradients, no glossy highlights, no fine lines; one bold shape that reads at 24 pixels.
